name: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape | Honey & Chocolate
desc:
🍯 Welcome to +1 Speed Keyboard Escape | Honey & Chocolate! 🍫

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed!
👟 Run, jump, and escape across a world made of honey & chocolate keyboard keys!
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful multipliers!
👥 Race against friends and other players!
🌍 Become the FASTEST on the server!
🚀 Speed is everything… but one wrong move and you’re back at the start! 😱

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing honey sounds for a perfect mix of speed & chill! ✨
